name: VectorSpace
tagline: Local-first vector design, prototyping and live collaboration
summary: VectorSpace is a local-first vector design, prototyping and collaborative editing workspace built with Uno Platform and SkiaSharp. Its browser host runs real C# through Uno WebAssembly—not an HTML mockup, WebView wrapper or embedded third-party editor—and shares one workbench with Windows, macOS and Linux. An optional self-hosted ASP.NET service adds shared editing, remote cursors, comments and role-based invitations.

highlights.title: Infinite canvas in C#
highlights.text: An infinite canvas with a floating tool palette and contextual properties, painted by SkiaSharp through Uno's SKCanvasElement—no parallel HTML editor.

highlights.title: Precise vector editing
highlights.text: Cubic pen and freehand paths, anchor and handle editing, exact de Casteljau curve subdivision and Boolean operations.

highlights.title: Auto-layout and constraints
highlights.text: Horizontal/vertical flow, wrapping, grid tracks and spans, padding and gaps, hug/fill sizing and edge or scale constraints.

highlights.title: Layered appearance
highlights.text: Stack solid, gradient and image paints with Fill/Fit/Crop/Tile, crop images directly on canvas, and add shadows and layer blur.

highlights.title: Local design systems
highlights.text: Component sets and variants, linked instances with overrides, and typed variables with aliases and inherited modes.

highlights.title: Interactive prototypes
highlights.text: An isolated playback runtime with flows, triggers, conditions, modal overlays, runtime variables and smart-matched transitions.

highlights.title: Self-hosted collaboration
highlights.text: Shared edits, remote cursors, participant following and synchronized comments against your own server, with per-user guarded undo.

highlights.title: Local-first recovery
highlights.text: No account for local work: recovery uses IndexedDB in the browser and the app-data folder on desktop, and Save downloads a real .vectorspace file.

items: Primitive shapes plus frames, sections and slices
Cubic pen and freehand pencil with configurable simplification tolerance
Point mode: multi-anchor selection, Smooth / Mirrored / Corner handles
Exact cubic subdivision, reverse path, open/close path and simplify freehand
Guides and Boolean operations
Scoped, deep and marquee selection plus matching-property selection
Eight anchored resize handles, rotation, flips and Alt-drag duplication
Gesture-scoped snapping, cursor-anchored zoom and pan
Inline text editing and paste in place at the recorded world position
Horizontal/vertical flow with wrapping
Grid layout with fixed, auto and fraction tracks and spans
Padding, gaps, constrained fill and axis-preserving hug/fill resize
Absolute children and edge/scale constraints
Layered solid, gradient and image paints with per-fill blend and reordering
PNG, JPEG and WebP placement with Fill, Fit, Crop and Tile modes
Direct on-canvas image cropping with a thirds grid
Strokes, dashes, opacity and blend modes
Independent drop and inner shadows plus layer blur
Local component sets, variants and linked instances
Supported overrides with stable descendant IDs across swaps
Color, number, string and boolean variables with aliases and modes
Dependency-aware clipboard and file operations
Named flows and a dedicated player with Back, Restart and Close
Click, press/release, enter/leave, key and delay triggers
Ordered actions, typed conditions and runtime variables
Modal overlays, frame scrolling and interactive variants
Instant, dissolve, move-in, push and name-matched smart transitions
Shared property and hierarchy edits with authoritative ordering
Remote cursors, selections and participant following
Synchronized comments with concurrent reply append
Viewer, commenter, editor and owner invitations with revocation
Persistent server revisions with download and conditional restore

codeSamples.title: Embed the workbench
Render a frame without Uno
Run a persistent collaboration server
codeSamples.code:
export VECTORSPACE_CREATE_KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
export VECTORSPACE_DATA="$HOME/.local/share/VectorSpace/rooms"
dotnet run --project server/VectorSpace.Server -c Release \
  --urls http://127.0.0.1:5097

# Alternative, with a named persistent Docker volume:
docker compose up --build -d

shortcuts.keys: Ctrl G / Ctrl Shift G / Shift A
Ctrl S / Ctrl O / Ctrl K

playground.intro: The live browser build is the full C# editor running on WebAssembly—open a sample playground and edit every shape, paint and interaction.

tour.title: Open a playground
tour.text: Press Ctrl+K and choose Prototype playground or Appearance playground to load an editable original sample.

tour.title: Draw a path
tour.text: Press P, click-drag to pull Bézier handles and click the first anchor to close. Press Enter on a shape to edit its vector points.

tour.title: Try auto-layout
tour.text: Select some layers and press Shift A, then adjust direction, gaps, padding and hug/fill sizing in the properties panel.

tour.title: Place and crop an image
tour.text: Press Ctrl+Shift+K to place a PNG, JPEG or WebP, switch between Fill, Fit, Crop and Tile, then choose Edit image crop to drag it on canvas.

tour.title: Present the prototype
tour.text: In the prototype playground choose Present prototype, click Explore the details, open the overlay, and use Back, Restart or R.

tour.title: Save a real file
tour.text: Press Ctrl+S to download an editable .vectorspace document, or export SVG/PNG.

architecture.name: Scene model
architecture.text: Platform-independent scene graph, geometry, variables and reactions with stable node IDs.

architecture.name: Engines
architecture.text: UI-free net10.0 libraries for layout, documents, transactional editing, prototype playback and collaboration.

architecture.name: Rendering
architecture.text: SkiaSharp scene rendering with retained resources, hit testing, Boolean paths and PNG export.

architecture.name: Uno surfaces
architecture.text: Reusable Uno controls and the embeddable design canvas, prototype player and presence overlay.

architecture.name: Workbench
architecture.text: Composes authoring, sharing, recovery and history into the complete browser/desktop workspace.

boundaries: Independent of Figma: no native .fig/FigJam interchange, remote libraries, plugin execution or full Dev Mode
GitHub Pages hosts only the client; cross-device sharing needs your own HTTPS server with persistent disk
No vector networks, multi-contour topology editing, variable-width strokes or mixed rich-text runs
Collaboration merges properties, not characters or path anchors; capability links are not SSO identity
Browser recovery storage is not a backup service; save .vectorspace copies explicitly
